description: Web resources: Add bookSourceDebug standalone HTML/CSS/JS page, simple-web lightweight mobile frontend with templates (reader/rss/search pages), and the compiled Vue web frontend with background images. Also add simplelogger.properties.
steps: Step 1: Copy the bookSourceDebug directory from /workspace/jarx/BOOT-INF/classes/bookSourceDebug/ to src/main/resources/bookSourceDebug/. This contains index.html, index.css, index.js for a standalone book source debugger UI.

Step 2: Copy the simple-web directory from /workspace/jarx/BOOT-INF/classes/simple-web/ to src/main/resources/simple-web/. This contains index.html, reader.html, rss.html, search.html and assets/ directory with CSS/JS/font/template files for a lightweight mobile-friendly frontend.

Step 3: Copy the compiled web frontend from /workspace/jarx/BOOT-INF/classes/web/ to src/main/resources/web/. This contains the compiled Vue app with bg/ (background images), bookSourceDebug/, css/, fonts/, img/, js/, index.html, and service worker files. NOTE: The dev repo has a web/ directory with Vue source at project root - the resources/web/ is the COMPILED output that gets bundled in the jar. Do NOT overwrite the project-root web/ source directory.
Step 4: Create src/main/resources/simplelogger.properties with content: org.slf4j.simpleLogger.showDateTime=true and org.slf4j.simpleLogger.dateTimeFormat=MM-dd HH:mm:ss

Step 5: Update YueduApi.kt to register static handlers for the new web resources: simple-web routes (router.route("/simple-web/*").handler(StaticHandler.create("simple-web").setDefaultContentEncoding("UTF-8"))), bookSourceDebug routes (router.route("/bookSourceDebug/*").handler(StaticHandler.create("bookSourceDebug").setDefaultContentEncoding("UTF-8"))). The main web/ static handler already exists.
acceptance_criteria: bookSourceDebug/ directory exists in src/main/resources/ with index.html, index.css, index.js
simple-web/ directory exists in src/main/resources/ with all HTML files and assets
web/ directory exists in src/main/resources/ with compiled Vue frontend including bg/ images
YueduApi.kt has static handlers for all new web resource paths
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/reader-dev && ./gradlew -b cli.gradle clean assemble --info 2>&1 | tail -20
findings: Had to remove /src/main/resources/web and /simple-web/ entries from .gitignore so the web resource directories could be tracked by git. Build passes cleanly. The existing catch-all static handler for web/ already serves the compiled Vue frontend - added new specific routes for /simple-web/* and /bookSourceDebug/* before the catch-all.
